chapter_119.category_name: Remembrance immediately after salam of the witr prayer
chapter_119.arabic: سبحان الملك القدوس ثلاث مرات والثالثة يجهر بها ويمد بها صوته ربِّ الملائكةِ والرّوح
chapter_119.transliteration: Subḥāna 'l-Maliki 'l-Quddūs. [Recite three times, and raise and extend the voice on the third time and say...] Rabbi 'l-Malā'ikati war-rūh.
chapter_119.translation: Glory is to the King, the Holy. [Recite three times in Arabic, and raise and extend the voice on the third time and say...] Lord of the angels and the Spirit.
chapter_119.title: Remembrance immediately after salam of the witr prayer - Hisn al-Muslim 119
chapter_119.reference: An-Nasa'i 3/244, Ad-Daraqutni and others. The final addition is from Ad-Daraqutni's version 2/31 and its chain of narration is authentic. See the checking of Zadul-Ma'ad by Shu'aib Al-Arna'ut and 'Abdul-Qadir Al-Arna'ut 1/337.
chapter_119.repetitions: Three times (third time with raised voice)

chapter_120.arabic: رَكِبَ صلى الله عليه وسلم الْقَصْوَاءَ حَتَّى أَتَى الْمَشْعَرَ الْحَرَامَ فَاسْتَقْبَلَ الْقِبْلَةَ (فَدَعَاهُ، وَكَبَّرَهُ، وَهَللَّهُ، وَوَحَّدَهُ) فَلَمْ يَزَلْ وَاقِفاً حَتَّى أَسْفَرَ جِدَّاً فَدَفَعَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تَطْلُعَ الشَّمسُ.
chapter_120.transliteration: He (ﷺ) rode Al-Qaswa until he reached Al-MashAAar Al-Haram, he then faced the qiblah, supplicated to Allah, and extoled His greatness and oneness. He stood until the sun shone but left before it rose.
chapter_120.translation: He (ﷺ) rode Al-Qaswa until he reached Al-Mashaar Al-Haram, he then faced the qiblah, supplicated to Allah, and exalted His greatness and oneness. He stood until the sun shone but left before it rose.
chapter_120.title: Remembrance at Muzdalifa - Hisn al-Muslim 120

chapter_121.category_name: Takbir when throwing each pebble at the Jamarat
chapter_121.arabic: يُكَبِّرُ كُلَّمَا رَمَى بِحَصَاةٍ عِنْدَ الْجِمَارِ الثَّلاَثِ، ثُمَّ يَتَقَدَّمُ، ويَقِفُ يَدْعُو مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبلَةِ، رَافِعاً يَدَيْهِ بَعْدَ الْجَمْرَةِ الْأُولَى وَالثَّانِيَةِ. أَمَّا جَمْرَةُ الْعَقَبَةِ فَيَرْمِيهَا وَيُكَبِّرُ عِنْدَ كُلِّ حَصَاةٍ وَيَنْصَرِفُ وَلاَ يَقِفُ عِنْدَهَا
chapter_121.transliteration: The Prophet (ﷺ) said Allāhu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah, and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after (stoning) the first and second pillars. As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allāhu Akbar with every pebble he threw, but when he was finished he left without standing at it (for supplications).
chapter_121.translation: The Prophet (ﷺ) said Allāhu Akbar (Allah is the Most Great) with each pebble he threw at the three pillars. Then he went forward, stood facing the Qiblah, and raised his hands and called upon Allah. That was after (stoning) the first and second pillars. As for the third, he stoned it and called out Allāhu Akbar with every pebble he threw, but when he was finished he left without standing at it (for supplications).
chapter_121.title: Takbir when throwing each pebble at the Jamarat - Hisn al-Muslim 239
chapter_121.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 3/581, 3, 4, and Muslim

chapter_122.category_name: At times of amazement and that which delights
chapter_122.title: At times of amazement and that which delights - Hisn al-Muslim 240
chapter_122.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 1/210, 390, 414 and Muslim 4/1857.

chapter_122.category_name: At times of amazement and that which delights
chapter_122.title: At times of amazement and that which delights - Hisn al-Muslim 241
chapter_122.reference: Al-Bukhari, cf. Al-Asqalani, Fathul-Bari 8/441. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 2/103, 235, Ahmad 5/218.

chapter_123.arabic: كَانَ النَّبيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِذَا أَتَاهُ أَمْرٌ يَسُرُّهُ أَوْ يُسَرُّ بِهِ خَرَّ سَاجِداً شُكْراً لِلَّهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى
chapter_123.translation: The Prophet (ﷺ), upon receiving news which pleased him or which caused pleasure, would prostrate in gratitude to Allah blessed and exalted.
chapter_123.title: Prostration of gratitude upon receiving pleasant news
chapter_123.reference: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/233, and 'Irwa'ul-Ghalil 2/226.

chapter_124.arabic: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْـت سُـبْحانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْـتُ مِنَ الظّـالِميـن
chapter_124.transliteration: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn.
chapter_124.translation: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.
chapter_124.title: For one in distress - Hisn al-Muslim 124
chapter_124.reference: At-Tirmidhi 5/529. Al-Hakim declared it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed with him 1/ 505. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/168.

chapter_125.arabic: اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّي لا أُشْـرِكُ بِهِ شَيْـئاً
chapter_125.transliteration: Allāh, Allāhu Rabbī lā ushriku bihi shay'ā
chapter_125.translation: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.
chapter_125.title: Supplication of Refuge and Trust in Allah

chapter_126.category_name: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority
chapter_126.arabic: اللّهُـمَّ إِنا نَجْـعَلُكَ في نُحـورِهِـم، وَنَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شُرورِهـمْ
chapter_126.transliteration: Allahumma inna naj'aluka fi nuhurihim, wa na'udhu bika min shururihim.
chapter_126.translation: O Allah, we ask You to restrain them by their necks, and we seek refuge in You from their evil.
chapter_126.title: Upon encountering an enemy or those of authority - Hisn al-Muslim 126
chapter_126.reference: Abu Dawud 2/89, and Al-Hakim graded it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed 2/142

chapter_127.category_name: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice
chapter_127.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ وَاللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ [اللَّهُمَّ مِنْكَ وَلَكَ] اللَّهُمَّ تَقَبَّلْ مِنِّي
chapter_127.transliteration: Bismillāh wallāhu Akbar [Allāhumma minka wa lak] Allāhumma taqabbal minnī
chapter_127.translation: With the Name of Allah, Allah is the Most Great! [O Allah, from You and to You.] O Allah, accept it from me.
chapter_127.title: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice - Hisn al-Muslim 246
tags: When slaughtering or offering a sacrifice

chapter_128.category_name: To ward off the plot of the rebellious devils
chapter_128.arabic: أَعُوذُ بكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّاتِ الَّتِي لَا يُجَاوِزُهُنَّ بَرٌّ ولَا فَاجرٌ مِنْ شّرِّ مَا خَلقَ، وبَرَأَ وذَرَأَ، ومِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَنْزِلُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وِمنْ شَرِّ مَا يَعْرُجُ فيهَا، ومِن شَرِّ مَا ذَرَأَ في الأَرْضِ ومِنْ شَرِّ مَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا، وِمنْ شَرِّ فِتَنِ اللَّيْلِ والنَّهارِ، ومِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ طارِقٍ إِلَّا طَارِقاً يَطْرُقُ بخَيْرٍ يَا رَحْمَنُ
chapter_128.transliteration: A'ūdhu bikalimāti 'llāhit-tāmmāti 'llatī lā yujāwizuhunna barrun wa lā fājirun min sharri mā khalaq, wa bara'a wa dhara', wa min sharri mā yanzilu minas-samā', wa min sharri mā ya'ruju fīhā, wa min sharri mā dhara'a fi 'l-arḍ, wa min sharri ma yakhruju minhā, wa min sharri fitani 'llayli wannahār, wa min sharri kulli ṭāriqin illā ṭāriqan yaṭruqu bikhayr yā Rahmān.
chapter_128.translation: Allah is sufficient for us and the best of those on whom to depend.
chapter_128.title: To ward off the plot of the rebellious devils - Hisn al-Muslim 128
chapter_128.reference: Ahmad 3/419, with an authentic chain of narration, and Ibn As-Sunni (no. 637). Al-Arna'ut, graded its chain authentic in his checking of Al-'Aqidah At-Tahawiyyah p. 133. See also Majma'uz-Zawa'id, 10/127.
tags: To ward off the plot of the rebellious devils

chapter_129.category_name: For one afraid of the ruler's injustice
chapter_129.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ ربَّ السَّمَوَاتِ السَّبْعِ، وَرَبَّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ، كُنْ لِي جَاراً مِنْ فُلاَنِ بْنِ فُلاَنٍ، وَأَحْزَابِهِ مِنْ خَلاَئِقِكَ، أَنْ يَفْرُطَ عَلَيَّ أَحَدٌ مِنْهُمْ أَوْ يَطْغَى، عَزَّ جَارُكَ، وَجَلَّ ثَنَاؤُكَ، وَلاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
chapter_129.transliteration: Allāhumma Rabba as-samāwāti as-sab', wa Rabba al-'arshi al-'aẓīm, kun lī jāran min fulānibni fulān, wa aḥzābihi min khalā'iqik, an yafruṭa 'alayya aḥadun minhum aw yaṭghā, 'azza jāruk, wa jalla thanā'uk, wa lā ilāha illā ant
chapter_129.translation: O Allah, Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Magnificent Throne, be a shelter for me from so-and-so son of so-and-so and his allies from among Your creatures, lest any of them abuse me or do me wrong. Mighty is Your patronage and glorious are Your praises. There is none worthy of worship but You.
chapter_129.title: For one afraid of the ruler's injustice - Hisn al-Muslim 129
tags: For one afraid of the ruler's injustice

chapter_130.arabic: الله أكبر، الله أعز من خلقه جميعاً، الله أعز مما أخاف وأحذر، أعوذ بالله الذي لا إله إلا هو، الممسك السموات السبع أن يقعن على الأرض إلا بإذنه، من شر عبدك فلان، وجنوده وأتباعه وأشياعه، من الجن والأنس، اللهم كن لي جاراً من شرهم، جل ثناؤك وعز جارك، وتبارك اسمك، ولا إله غيرك
chapter_130.transliteration: Allāhu Akbar, Allāhu a'azzu min khalqihi jamī'a, Allāhu a'azzu mimmā akhāfu wa aḥdhar, a'ūdhu billāhi 'l-ladhī lā ilāha illā hū, almumsikis-samāwātis-sab'i an yaqa'na 'ala 'l-arḍi illā bi idhnih, min sharri 'abdika [name of the person], wa junūdihi wa atbā'ihi wa ashyā'ih, mina 'l-jinni wa 'l-ins, Allāhumma kun lī jāran min sharrihim, jalla thanā'uk, wa 'azza jāruk, wa tabāraka-smuk, wa lā ilāha ghayruk.
chapter_130.translation: Allah is the Most Great, Mightier than all His creation. He is Mightier than what I fear and dread. I seek refuge in Allah, Who there is none worthy of worship but Him. He is the One Who holds the seven heavens from falling upon the earth except by His command. [I seek refuge in You Allah] from the evil of Your slave [name of the person], and his helpers, his followers, and his supporters from among the jinn and mankind. O Allah, be my support against their evil. Glorious are Your praises and mighty is Your patronage. Blessed is Your Name, there is no true God but You.
chapter_130.title: Fear of rulers' injustice - Hisn al-Muslim 130

chapter_131.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُنْزِلَ الْكِتَابِ سَرِيعَ الْحِسَابِ اهْزِمِ الأَحْزَابَ اللَّهُمَّ اهْزِمْهُمْ وَزَلْزِلْهُمْ
chapter_131.transliteration: Allāhumma munzila 'l-kitāb, sarī'a 'l-ḥisāb, ihzimi 'l-aḥzāb, Allāhumma-hzimhum wa zalzilhum
chapter_131.translation: O Allah, Revealer of the Book, Swift to account, defeat the groups (of disbelievers). O Allah, defeat them and shake them.
chapter_131.title: Against enemies - Hisn al-Muslim 131

chapter_132.category_name: When being afraid of a group of people
chapter_132.translation: O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish.
chapter_132.title: When being afraid of a group of people - Hisn al-Muslim 132
